name: CanvasNavigator
intent: Drill-in hierarchy navigator for a canvas: branches expand to any depth, leaves are selectable.

usage: Use CanvasNavigator to help users navigate through your application or content hierarchy. This component provides clear wayfinding and helps users understand their current location within the interface.

CanvasNavigator is ideal for multi-page applications, content-heavy interfaces, or any situation where users need to move between different sections. Keep navigation patterns consistent across your application for better user experience.

props.name: nodes
props.description: Hierarchical nodes (branches + leaves) shown in the navigator.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected node id (controlled).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selected node id (uncontrolled). Defaults to the first (top-level) node.

props.name: expandedIds
props.description: Expanded branch ids in the full-tree (expanded) view. Defaults to every branch expanded.

props.name: size
props.description: Panel size (controlled): collapse to a header, or expand to go big.

props.name: expandable
props.description: Show the expand ("go big") control in the header. Default true. The collapse control always shows.

props.name: collapseIcon
props.description: Icon for the header's collapse control. Defaults to a chevron-up. Override it (e.g. with a panel icon) when the navigator is docked as a sidebar and "collapse" reads as "hide the panel".

props.name: title
props.description: Header title shown at the top level.

props.name: header
props.description: Render the header (with collapse + expand controls). Default true.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show a search bar in the header. While searching, the tree is replaced by a flat list of matching locations, each shown as its full breadcrumb path (start-truncated to one line).

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder for the search input. Default "Search…".

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Message shown when a branch has no children (e.g. a level with nothing under it).

props.name: truncate
props.description: Long-name handling for rows. Omit for plain end truncation. `"end"` adds a hover tooltip with the full name when it's clipped; `"middle"` keeps the start + tail visible (good for filenames like `Plan_Rev3.svg`); `"clamp"` wraps the name onto up to `maxLines` lines before truncating. All add a tooltip with the full name.

props.name: tailChars
props.description: For `truncate="middle"`, how many trailing characters to always keep visible. Default 7.

props.name: maxLines
props.description: For `truncate="clamp"`, the maximum number of wrapped lines before truncating. Default 3.

props.name: compact
props.description: Compact density — 12px text on rows, header, search, and results, with tighter spacing. Default false.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show a loading bar docked to the bottom of the panel while locations are still loading. Default false.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Text shown next to the spinner in the loading bar. Default "Loading…".

props.name: shiftAfterLevel
props.description: Deep-tree horizontal shift. When set, expanding branches past this (1-based) level slides the default tree left by one indent step — the gap between level 1 and level 2 — for each level revealed beyond it, so the active deep path stays in view. Collapsing a level shifts it back. Omit to disable (the tree never shifts).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply.

props.name: children
props.description: Child elements to render.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element, merging props and behavior.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component is disabled.

bestPractices.title: Use semantic props
bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Don't override core styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using className to override the component's fundamental styling.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states
bestPractices.description: Account for loading, error, empty, and success states.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing broken UI when data is missing or loading.
